context: MISC register bits 9 through 15 define RPCNTL1 through RPCNTL3, which permit CSRRD reads of implemented performance counters at PLV1 through PLV3 without triggering an instruction privilege level error exception, and ALCL0 through ALCL3, which enable non-alignment checks for non-vector load/store instructions at each privilege level, triggering an address alignment error exception when illegal.
